title: Masked Erosion: How Acceptance Gates Lose Redundant Safeguards in Self-Improving Agents
why: Audit of harness self-improvement acceptance gates: agents edit prompts/rules around a fixed model; overlapping safeguards mask deletions so gates optimize task success while safety redundancy erodes. evaluation_signal: Author-reported: harm measured over subsets of four written safeguards in two agent environments; 411 improvement loops / ten gate rules; mostly controlled deletions plus three GEPA runs; batch-size effects (20 vs 40 tasks) and weaker-model reuse harm.
